**Big but doable. Three zones must keep `account_id`.**

| Zone | Files | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| `services/**` | 75 | Yes, ~1200 refs |
| `migrations/**` | 12 | No, applied history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 4 | No, regenerated by `npm run vendor:refresh` |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` and wire keys | 2 | No, frozen public contract |

175 service refs sit in SQL strings. They name the live DB column. A new migration must rename it first.

In [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) flip the left key only. It must read `owner_id: 'account_id'`.

[lib/audit.js:8](lib/audit.js:8) reads the key by name. Rename it in lockstep.
